subject: Are we still on track? procurement status after legal redlines
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@finwise.com>, Ben Park <ben.park@finwise.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (integration, timelines, procurement)

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. High-level recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

- Scope: pilot (50k tokens/month) for payments reconciliation use-case; API endpoints + webhook for event callbacks.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for common flows; <5% edge-case failures.
- Security: will require SOC 2 attestation and data residency note (we discussed US-only).
- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement + counsel will review contract and financial terms; Ben and Lydia to own that.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will send the draft MSA and SOW to procurement/legal by end of day Friday (attached).
2) FinWise legal to return redlines (or confirm), then we iterate.
3) Target pilot start: Oct 4 if contract clears.

Attachments: draft-MSA-SOW-Redwood-20270901.pdf (attached)

If priorities have shifted on your side, please let me know — happy to compress timelines or propose an interim pilot arrangement.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

--

[Attachment stub: draft-MSA-SOW-Redwood-20270901.pdf]

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@finwise.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Park <ben.park@finwise.com>, procurement@finwise.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (integration, timelines, procurement)

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear recap. I shared the draft with our outside counsel this morning and we attached a set of redlines for your team to review. Ben will also coordinate with procurement on payment terms and timing.

Please find the redlines attached. Primary asks from counsel:
- Clarify data handling / deletion timeline (30 days after retention window).
- Add warranty carve-outs around third-party data.
- Insert a standard indemnity clause with $X cap for model outputs.

We still want to move forward; counsel just needs to confirm wording. Expect to push the doc back to you early next week if there are no surprises.

Thanks,
Lydia
Head of Integrations, FinWise
lydia.chen@finwise.com | +1 (617) 555-1999

--

[Attachment stub: FinWise_redlines_20270903.pdf]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FinWise redlines — quick read + proposed responses

Monica / Marcus — forwarding FinWise redlines (attached). I sketched a short response/delta (naomi_response_draft_20270905.docx) that softens the warranty language, proposes a 60-day data deletion for backups, and suggests an indemnity cap tied to fees for the first 12 months.

Could you: 
- Monica: glance at the data handling clause and confirm whether 60 days is acceptable operationally, or whether we should propose 45 days with an implementation plan.
- Marcus: legal trade-offs on indemnity cap and whether a liability cap tied to fees is reasonable for a pilot.

Goal: reply to Lydia with a tracked-changes version by EOD Tue to keep pilot window intact.

Thanks — Naomi

[Attachment stub: naomi_response_draft_20270905.docx]

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@finwise.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Park <ben.park@finwise.com>, procurement@finwise.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Are we still on track? procurement status after legal redlines

Hi Naomi — quick status update from our side. Counsel reviewed your notes and we had a short follow-up call this morning. Procurement has shifted priorities slightly (end-of-quarter budgeting constraints), so we may not finalize the MSA this week. Counsel still has two small open items (final language on deletion window and indemnity cap).

I expect a final position from procurement/counsel by Friday (2027-09-10). If that slips, we'll circle back immediately. For transparency: if procurement needs to push to the next budget cycle, we may need to re-evaluate pilot sizing, but that's not the default.

I'll confirm by Friday. If helpful, can you provide a one-paragraph fallback SOW that limits scope to only the highest-priority endpoints (we can sign that faster)? Also attaching FinWise SOC request form we got from Security so you can attach our attestation in the pilot packet.

Best,
Lydia

[Attachment stub: SOC2_request_20270907.pdf]
